bihanwa n’amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu, iyo
imyitwarire ikurikira ikozwe ku bushake kandi nta
burenganzira:
gutuka mu ruhame, binyuze mu rusobe rwa
mudasobwa,
(i) abantu kubera ko ari abo mu itsinda ryihariye
ry'ubwoko, ibara ry'uruhu, inkomoko cyangwa
ubwenegihugu cyangwa ubwoko, n'idini, iyo
bikoreshejwe nk'urwitwazo rw'imwe muri izo
mpamvu; cyangwa
(ii) itsinda ry'abantu ryihariye bitewe na bimwe
muri ibyo bintu.
2. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
gishobora:
a. gusaba ko icyaha kivugwa mu gika cya mbere
cy'iyi ngingo kigira ingaruka z’uko umuntu
cyangwa itsinda ry'abantu bavugwa mu gika cya
mbere bagaragarizwa urwango, gusuzugurwa
cyangwa gusebywa; cyangwa
b. kwigenera uburenganzira bwo kudakurikiza
ibiteganywa n’igika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo,
byose cyangwa igice.

articles.heading: Gukoresha nabi ibikoresho 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
articles.text:
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
bishyirwe mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe kandi nta burenganzira:
a. gukora, kugurisha, gutanga amasoko yo
gukoresha, gutumiza mu mahanga,
gukwirakwiza cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo
kubona:
i. igikoresho, harimo porogaramu ya
mudasobwa, cyagenewe cyangwa
cyateguriwe mbere na mbere hagamijwe
gukora icyaha icyo ari cyo cyose
cyashyizweho hakurikijwe ingingo ya 2
kugeza ku ya 5;
ii. ijambo ry’ibanga rya mudasobwa, imibare
yo kwinjira, cyangwa amakuru asa na yo
ashobora gukoreshwa mu kwinjira muri
sisitemu ya mudasobwa yose cyangwa igice
cyayo, hagamijwe ko akoreshwa mu rwego
rwo gukora kimwe mu byaha bivugwa mu
ngingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 5; no
b. gutunga ikintu kivugwa mu bika a.i
cyangwa ii biri haruguru, hagamijwe ko
cyakoreshwa mu gukora kimwe mu byaha
bivugwa mu ngingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 5.
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora
gusaba gikoresheje amategeko ko ibintu
bimwe mu bigize icyaha biba bihari mbere
y’uko habaho uburyozwacyaha.
2. Iyi ngingo ntigomba gusobanurwa nk’
ishyiraho uburyozwe bw’icyaha mu gihe
gukora, kugurisha, gutanga amasoko kugira
ngo gukoresha, kwinjiza, gukwirakwiza
cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gutanga cyangwa
kugaragaza nk'uko bivugwa mu gika cya 1
cy'iyi ngingo bidakozwe hagamijwe gukora
icyaha giteganyijwe hakurikijwe ingingo ya 2
kugeza ku ya 5 y'aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga, nko mu igerageza ryemewe
cyangwa kurinda urusobe rwa mudasobwa.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kwigenera uburenganzira bwo
kudakurikiza ibiteganywa n’igika cya 1
cy’iyi ngingo, mu gihe uko kwifata kutareba
ibyo kugurisha, gukwirakwiza cyangwa
ubundi buryo bwo kubona ibintu bivugwa mu
gika cya 1 a.ii cy’iyi ngingo.
UMUTWE 2: IBYAHA BIJYANYE NA
MUDASOBWA

articles.heading: Kwigana ibijyanye na mudasobwa Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
articles.text:
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
bishyirwe mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe kandi nta burenganzira,
kwinjiza, guhindura, gusiba, cyangwa gusiba
burundu amakuru abitse muri mudasobwa,
bigatuma amakuru atari yo afatwa,
bigambiriwe, nk’amakuru y’impamo mu
buryo bukurikije amategeko, hatitawe ko
amakuru asomeka neza kandi yumvikana
cyangwa bitameze gutyo. Igihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano gishobora gusaba ko
hagaragazwa kugambirira kuriganya,
cyangwa undi mugambi nk'uwo w'ubuhemu,
mbere yo kuryozwa icyaha.

articles.heading: Uburiganya bujyanye na mudasobwa Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
articles.text:
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
bishyirwe mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe kandi nta burenganzira, bigateza
undi muntu gutakaza umutungo binyuze mu:
a. igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose cyo kwinjiza,
guhindura, gusiba cyangwa gusiba burundu
amakuru abitse muri mudasobwa,
b. ivogera iryo ari ryo ryose mu mikorere
y’urusobe rwa mudasobwa, hagamijwe
uburiganya cyangwa ubuhemu mu gushaka
inyungu z'ubukungu z’umuntu ku giti cye
cyangwa z’uwundi muntu, nta burenganzira.
UMUTWE WA 3: IBYAHA BISHINGIYE
KU BIGIZE IBITANGAZWA

articles.heading: Ibyaha bijyanye n’amashusho y’urukozasoni hifashishijwe abana 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zikenewe kugira ngo bishyirwe mu byaha
bihanwa n’amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu,
iyo imyitwarire ikurikira ikozwe igambiriwe
kandi nta burenganzira bwo:
a. gukora amashusho y’urukozasoni
akoreshejwe umwana hagamijwe
kuyakwirakwiza binyuze mu urusobe rwa
mudasobwa;
b. gutanga cyangwa kugaragaza amashusho
y’urukozasoni rukoreshejwe abana binyuze
mu rusobe rwa mudasobwa;
c. gukwirakwiza cyangwa kohereza
amashusho y’urukozasoni rukoreshejwe
abana binyuze mu rusobe rwa mudasobwa;
d. kubona amashusho y’urukozasoni
rukoreshejwe abana binyuze mu rusobe rwa
mudasobwa ku muntu ku giti cye cyangwa ku
wundi muntu;
e. gutunga amashusho y’urukozasoni
rukoreshejwe abana mu rusobe rwa
mudasobwa cyangwa mu bubiko bwa
mudasobwa.
2. Ku bw’igika cya 1 haruguru, ijambo
"urukozasoni rukoreshejwe abana"
rikubiyemo n'ibikoresho byerekana
amashusho y’urukozasoni mu buryo
bugaragara:
a. umwana muto ukora imibonano
mpuzabitsina mu buryo butaziguye;
b. umuntu ugaragara nk’umwana wishora mu
mibonano mpuzabitsina mu buryo
butaziguye;
c. amashusho nyakuri agaragaza umwana uri
mu bikorwa by’imibonano mpuzabitsina.
3. Ku bw’ igika cya 2haruguru, ijambo
"umwana" rikubiyemo abantu bose bari
munsi y’imyaka 18. Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gishobora, ariko, gushyiraho
ikigero cy’imyaka yo hasi, ariko ntikigomba
kuba munsi y'imyaka 16.
4. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kwifata ku bijyanye
n’uburenganzira bwo kudakurikiza, byose
cyangwa igice, ibikubiye mu gika cya 1,
uduka d na e, n’icya 2, uduka b na c.
UMUTWE WA 4: IBYAHA BIJYANYE
NO KUVOGERA UBURENGANZIRA
BW’UMUHANZI N’UBURENGANZIRA
BUSHAMIKIYEHO

articles.heading: Ibyaha bijyanye no kuvogera uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi n’uburenganzira bushamikiyeho 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
bishyirwe mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, kuvogera
uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi, nk'uko
bisobanurwa n’itegeko ry’icyo gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano, hashingiwe ku
nshingano cyemeye hakurikijwe
Amasezerano ya Paris yo ku wa 24 Nyakanga
1971 avugurura Amasezerano
mpuzamahanga ya Bern ajyanye no
kurengera ibihangano by'ubuvanganzo
n'iby'ubugeni, Amasezerano mpuzamahanga
ku bijyanye n'uburenganzira ku mutungo
bwite mu by’ubwenge ukorerwaho ubucuruzi
n’Amasezerano y’Umuryango
mpuzamahanga ugamije kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge, ku
burenganzira bw’umuhanzi havuyemo
uburenganzira bwose bw'umuco buteganywa
n'ayo Masezerano, iyo ibyo bikorwa
byakozwe bigambiriwe, ku rwego
rw'ubucuruzi kandi hakoreshejwe urusobe
rwa mudasobwa.
2. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba zose
zikenewe kugira ngo bishyirwe mu byaha
bihanwa hakurikijwe amategeko y’imbere
mu gihugu, ivogerwa ry’uburenganzira
bifitanye isano, nk'uko bisobanurwa
n’itegeko ry’icyo Gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano, hashingiwe ku nshingano
cyavanye mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga
agamije kurengera abahanzi bakina cyangwa
baririmba ibihangano, abakora za
fonogaramu cyangwa ibigo
nsakazamashusho cyangwa amajwi
(Amasezerano y'i Roma), Amasezerano
mpuzamahanga ku bijyanye n'uburenganzira
ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
ukorerwaho ubucuruzi, n’Amasezerano
y’Umuryango mpuzamahanga ugamije
kurengera umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge,
ku burenganzira bw’umuhanzi havuyemo
uburenganzira nyamuntu ubwo ari bwo
bwose buteganywa n'ayo Masezerano, iyo
ibyo bikorwa byakozwe bigambiriwe, ku
rwego rw'ubucuruzi kandi hakoreshejwe
urusobe rwa mudasobwa.
3. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kwigenera uburenganzira bwo
kudashyiraho uburyozwe ku cyaha
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’igika cya 1 n'icya
2 by'iyi ngingo mu gihe gito, hashingiwe ko
ubundi buryo bukwiye bwo gukemura
ikibazo buhari kandi ko uko kwifata
budaturuka ku nshingano mpuzamahanga
z'Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano zivugwa
mu Masezerano mpuzamahanga avugwa mu
gika cya 1 n'icya 2 by'iyi ngingo.
UMUTWE 5: UBUNDI BWOKO
BW’UBURYOZWE N’IBIHANO

articles.heading: Ubwinjiracyaha no gufasha cyangwa kuba icyitso 1. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
articles.text:
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
bishyirwe mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe, gufasha cyangwa kuba icyitso
ku ikorwa ry’icyaha icyo ari cyo cyose
cyateganyijwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 10 y’aya
Masezerano hagamijwe ko icyaha nk'icyo
gikorwa.
2. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba zose
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
bishyirwe mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe, kugerageza gukora icyaha icyo
ari cyo cyose cyateganyijwe hakurikijwe

articles.heading: Ukwifata n’amatangazo 1. Ukwifata n'amatangazo byakozwe n'Igihugu kiri muri Masezerano mu ngingo z’Amasezerano
articles.text:
biakurikizwa no kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, uretse iyo icyo gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera kibitangaje ukundi mu
gihe cyo gushyiraho umukono cyangwa mu gihe
cyo gutanga inyandiko yacyo yo kwemeza
burundu, kwemera, kwemeza cyangwa kwemera
kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera.
2. Binyuze mu imenyesha ryandikiwe
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Inama y'Ibihugu
by'Uburayi, igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri
aya Masezerano, mu gihe cyo gushyiraho
umukono cyangwa igihe cyo gutanga inyandiko
yacyo yo kwemeza burundu, kwemera, kwemeza
cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
gishobora gutangaza ko giha agaciro ukwifata
guteganywa mu ngingo ya 3, iya 5 n'iya 6 z'aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera. Mu gihe kimwe, igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera gishobora
guha agaciro, ku bijyanye n'ibiteganywa muri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, ukwifata guteganyijwe
mu ngingo ya 22, igika cya kabiri n'ingingo ya 41,
igika cya mbere cy’Amasezerano, hatitawe ku
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryakozwe n’icyo gihugu kiri
muri Masezerano hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’Amsezerano. Nta kundi kwifata gushobora
gukorwa.
3. Binyuze mu imenyesha ryandikiwe
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w'Inama y'ibihugu
by’Uburayi, igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora,
mu gihe cyo gushyiraho umukono cyangwa mu
gihe gitanga inyandiko yacyo yo kwemeza
burundu, kwemera, kwemeza cyangwa kwemera
kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, gitangaza ko giha
agaciro uburyo bwo gusaba ibisobanuro
by'inyongera nk'uko biteganywa mu ngingo ya 5,
igika cya 2.a, n'ingingo ya 6, igika cya 2.a, by'aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera.

articles.heading: Imimerere n’Ivanwaho ry’ukwifata 1. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera cyifashe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 12
articles.text:
yavuzwe haruguru gikuraho uko kwifata, kose
cyangwa igice, mu gihe bibaye ngombwa. Uko
gukuraho ukwifata kugira agaciro ku itariki
imenyesha ryandikiwe Umunyamabanga Mukuru
w’Inama y’ibihugu by’Uburayi ryakiriwe. Iyo
imenyesha rivuga ko kuvanaho ukwifata bigomba
kugira agaciro ku itariki iteganyijwemo, kandi iyo
tariki ikaba itarenze umunsi imenyesha
ryakiriweho n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru,
kuvanaho ukwifata bitangira gukurikizwa kuri iyo
tariki iza nyuma.
2. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama y’ibihugu
by’Uburayi ashobora kubaza buri gihe Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
byifashe rimwe cyangwa kenshi hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 12 ku byerekeye
gukuraho uko kwifata.

articles.heading: Imbibi na z’ingingo zijyanye n’imiburanishirize y’imanza 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba zose
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo
hashyirweho ububasha n’uburyo
buteganyijwe muri iki cyiciro hagamijwe
iperereza cyangwa imiburanishirize y’imanza
z’inshinjabyaha yihariye.
2. Usibye ibiteganyijwe ukundi mu ngingo ya
21, buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gikoresha ububasha n’uburyo buvugwa mu
gika cya 1 cy’iyi ngingo:
a. ibyaha by’inshinjabyaha byateganyijwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 2
kugeza ku ya 11 y'aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga;
b. ibindi byaha by’inshinjabyaha byakozwe
hakoreshejwe urusobe rwa mudasobwa; no
c. gukusanya ibimenyetso, by’ibyaha
by’inshinjabyaha, mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga.
3. a. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kwifata ku bijyanye
n’uburenganzira bwo gushyira mu bikorwa
ingamba zavuzwe mu ngingo ya 20 gusa ku
byaha cyangwa ibyiciro by’ibyaha bivugwa
muri uko kwifata, hitawe ko ubwinshi
bw’ibyaha cyangwa ibyiciro by’ibyaha
byavuzwe mu ngingo ya 21. Buri gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano kigomba kuzirikana
ibijyanye no kubuza uko kwifata kugira ngo
hashobore gukurikizwa mu buryo bwagutse
ingamba zavuzwe mu ngingo ya 20.
b. Iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano,
kubera imbogamizi ziri mu mategeko yacyo
akurikizwa mu gihe cyo kwemeza aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga, kidashobora
gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zavuzwe mu
ngingo ya 20 n'iya 21 ku bijyanye
n’itumanaho ririmo kunyuzwa mu rusobe rwa
mudasobwa ry’ushinzwe gutanga serivisi:
i. irimo gukoreshwa ku nyungu z'itsinda
ryihariye ry'abakoresha iryo koranabuhanga,
kandi
ii. idakoresha imiyoboro rusange y'itumanaho
kandi ikaba idahura n’urundi rusobe rwa
mudasobwa, byaba ibya Leta cyangwa
iby'abikorera ku giti cyabo, icyo gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gishobora kwifata mu
bijyanye n’uburenganzira bwo kudashyira
mu bikorwa izi ngamba kuri iryo tumanaho.
Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
giharanira kubuza ko habaho uko kwifata
kugira ngo gishobore gushyira mu bikorwa
mu buryo bwagutse cyane ingamba zivugwa
mu ngingo ya 20 n'iya 21.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa n'ingamba zo kwirinda 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano giharanira ko haba ishyirwaho, ishyirwa mu
articles.text:
bikorwa n’ikoreshwa ry’ububasha n’uburyo
biteganyijwe muri iki Cyiciro bigira ibisabwa
n’ubwirinzi biteganyijwe mu mategeko
yacyo, biteganya ukurengera, mu buryo
bukwiriye, uburenganzira n’ubwisanzure
bwa muntu, harimo n’uburenganzira
buturuka ku nshingano cyafashe hashingiwe
ku Masezerano mpuzamahanaga y'Inama
y'Uburayi yo mu 1950 yerekeye kurengera
uburenganzira bw'ikiremwamuntu
n'ubw'ibanze, Amasezerano mpuzamahanga
yerekeye uburengazira mu
by’imbonezamubano no mu bya politiki yo
mu 1966, n'andi masezerano mpuzamahanga
arebana n'uburenganzira bw'ikiremwamuntu
akurikizwa kandi akubiyemo ihame ryo
kuringaniza .
2. Ubwo buryo n’ubwirinzi bigomba, iyo
bikwiye hakurikijwe imiterere y’uburyo
cyangwa ububasha bwavuzwe, kuba
bikubiyemo, cyane cyane, kugenzurwa
n’urwego rw’ubucamanza cyangwa urundi
rwego rwigenga, impamvu zisobanura
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo, no gushyiraho
aho iyo mikorere ndetse n’igihe bigomba
kumara.
3. Mu gihe bihuje n'inyungu rusange, cyane
cyane imiyoborere myiza y’ubutabera, buri
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisuzuma
ingaruka z’ububasha n’uburyo biri muri iki
Gice ku burenganzira, inshingano n’inyungu
zemewe z’ibindi bitari muri aya Masezerano.
UMUTWE 2: KUBUNGABUNGA
BYIHUSE AMAKURU YA
MUDASOBWA ABITSWE

articles.heading: Kubungabunga byihuse amakuru ya mudasobwa abitswe 1. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
articles.text:
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo inzego
zibifitiye ububasha zitegeke cyangwa zisabe
mu bundi buryo ko amakuru yihariye yo mu
buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga, harimo n'amakuru
ajyanye n'itumanaho, abitswe hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga, agomba kubikwa vuba,
cyane cyane iyo hari impamvu zituma
hatekerezwa ko ayo makuru ashobora kubura
cyangwa guhindurwa.
2. Iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gikurikiza uko bikwiye ibiteganywa n’igika
cya 1 haruguru binyuze mu gutegeka umuntu
kubika amakuru yihariye ya mudasobwa afite
cyangwa agenzura, igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gifata ingamba z'amategeko
n'izindi ngamba zishobora kuba ngombwa zo
gusaba uwo muntu ko asigasira kandi
ubungabunga ubuziranenge bw'ayo makuru
ya mudasobwa mu gihe kirekire gishoboka,
ariko kitarenze iminsi mirongo icyenda,
kugira ngo inzego zibifitiye ububasha
zibashe kuyashyira ahagaragara. Igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gishobora gutegeka ko
icyo cyemezo cyo cyavugururwa nyuma.
3. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zishobora kuba ngombwa mu rwego rwo
gutegeka umurinzi cyangwa undi muntu
ugomba gusigasira amakuru ya mudasobwa
mu rwego rwo gukomeza kubika ibanga mu
bijyanye no gukora ubwo buryo mu gihe
giteganyijwe n’amategeko yacyo.
4. Ububasha n’uburyo buvugwa muri iyi
ngingo bigomba gukurikiza ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 14 n’iya 15.

articles.heading: Kubungabunga byihuse no gutangaza igice cy'amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishyiraho, ku bijyanye n’amakuru ajyanye
n’itumanaho agomba kubikwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 16, amategeko
n’izindi ngamba zishobora kuba ngombwa
mu rwego rwo:
a. guharanira ko gusigasira byihuse amakuru
ajyanye n’itumanaho bikorwa, hatitawe ko
utanga serivisi umwe cyangwa benshi bagize
uruhare mu kohereza ubwo butumwa; no
b. guharanira ko guhishurira amakuru
byihuse urwego rubifitiye ububasha
rw’igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano,
cyangwa umuntu washyizweho n'urwo
rwego, ingano ihagije y'amakuru ajyanye
n’itumanaho kugira ngo igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gishobore kugaragaza abatanga
serivisi n'inzira ikoreshwa mu gutanga
amakuru.
2. Ububasha n’uburyo buvugwa muri iyi
ngingo bigomba gukurikiza ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 14 n’iya 15.
UMUTWE WA 3: ITEGEKO RYO
GUTANGA AMAKURU

articles.heading: Itegeko ryo gutanga amakuru 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba zose
articles.text:
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo inzego
zibifitiye ububasha zitegeke:
a. umuntu uri ku butaka bwacyo gutanga
amakuru ya mudasobwa yihariye afite
cyangwa agenzura, abitswe mu rusobe rwa
mudasobwa cyangwa abitswe mu gikoresho
cya mudasobwa cyagenewe kubika amakuru;
na
b. utanga serivisi ku butaka bw’Igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gutanga amakuru
y’abiyandikishije ajyanye n’iyo serivisi
utanga serivisi afite cyangwa agenzura.
2. Ububasha n’uburyo buvugwa muri iyi
ngingo bigomba gukurikiza ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 14 n’iya 15.
3. Ku bw’iyi ngingo, ijambo "amakuru
y’abafatabuguzi" risobanura amakuru ayo ari
yo yose akubiye mu buryo bw’amakuru ya
mudasobwa cyangwa ubundi buryo ubwo ari
bwo bwose utanga serivisi afite, ajyanye
n’abafatabuguzi ba serivisi zabo atari
amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho cyangwa
amakuru ajyanye n'ibigize ibitangazwa ,
kandi ashobora kugaragaza:
a. ubwoko bw'itumanaho rikoreshwa,
ingamba za tekiniki zifatirwa kuri ryo ndetse
n'igihe itumanaho ribera;
b. umwirondoro, aderesi y'iposita cyangwa
y'ahantu abarizwa, nomero ya telefoni
by’umufatabuguzi n'indi mibare yo kwinjira
muri serivisi, amakuru ajyanye n'amafaranga
yishyurwa kuri serivisi, aboneka hashingiwe
ku masezerano ya serivisi;
c. andi makuru ayo ari yo yose yerekeranye
n'ahantu ibikoresho by'itumanaho bishyirwa,
aboneka hashingiwe ku masezerano ya
serivisi.
UMUTWE WA 4: GUSAKA NO
GUFATIRA AMAKURU ABITSWE
MURI MUDASOBWA

articles.heading: Gusaka no gufatira amakuru abitswe muri mudasobwa 1. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba zose
articles.text:
zikenewe kugira ngo inzego zibifitiye
ububasha zibashe gusaka cyangwa zibone
ubundi buryo nk’ubwo bwo kubona amakuru
ku:
a. urusobe rwa mudasobwa cyangwa igice
cyayo hamwe n’amakuru ya mudasobwa
abitswemo; no
b. igikoresho kigenewe kubika amakuru ya
mudasobwa amakuru ashobora kubikwaho ku
butaka bwacyo.
2. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo inzego
zacyo zibashe gusaka cyangwa zishobore
kugera ku rusobe rwa mudasobwa runaka
cyangwa igice cyayo, hashingiwe ku
biteganywa n’igika cya 1.a, kandi zifite
impamvu zo kwizera ko amakuru yasatswe
ari abitswe mu rundi rusobe rwa mudasobwa
cyangwa igice cyayo ku butaka bwacyo,
kandi ayo makuru ashobora kuboneka mu
buryo bwemewe n’amategeko cyangwa
kuboneka ku ikoranabuhanga ry’ibanze,
inzego zishobora kwihutisha kwagura isaka
cyangwa ubundi buryo nk’ubwo bwo
kwinjira mu rindi koranabuhanga.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zishobora kuba ngombwa kugira ngo inzego
zibifitiye ububasha zacyo zigire ububasha
bwo gufatira cyangwa kubona amakuru ya
mudasobwa aboneka hakurikijwe ibivugwa
mu gika cya 1 cyangwa icya 2. Izo ngamba
zigomba kuba zikubiyemo ububasha bwo:
a. gufatira cyangwa kubona mu buryo
nk’ubwo urusobe rwa mudasobwa cyangwa
igice cyayo cyangwa igikoresho cyagenewe
kubika amakuru ya mudasobwa;
b. gukora no gusigasira kopi y’aya makuru ya
mudasobwa;
c. kubumbatira ubusugire bw’amakuru
bijyanye abitswe muri mudasobwa;
d. gutuma amakuru ya mudasobwa
adashobora kwinjirwamo cyangwa gukurwa
mu rusobe rwa mudasobwa.
4. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zishobora gukenerwa mu rwego rwo guha
ububasha inzego zacyo zibishinzwe bwo
gutegeka umuntu uwo ari we wese ufite
ubumenyi ku mikorere y’urusobe rwa
mudasobwa cyangwa ingamba zikoreshwa
mu kurinda amakuru ayirimo gutanga, mu
buryo bushyize mu gaciro, amakuru akenewe
kugira ngo ibikorwa bivugwa mu gika cya 1
n'icya 2 bikorwe.
5. Ububasha n’uburyo bivugwa muri iyi
ngingo bigomba gukurikiza ibiteganywa
n’ingingo ya 14 na 15.
UMUTWE 5: GUKUSANYA AMAKURU
YA MUDASOBWA MU GIHE NYACYO

articles.heading: Gukusanya amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho mu gihe nyacyo 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zikenewe kugira ngo inzego zibifitiye
ububasha zigire ububasha bwo:
a. gukusanya cyangwa kwandika binyuze mu
buryo bwa tekiniki ku butaka bw'icyo gihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano, no
b. gutegeka utanga serivisi, mu bijyanye
n’ubushobozi bwe bwa tekiniki busanzweho:
i. gukusanya cyangwa kwandika binyuze mu
buryo bwa tekiniki ku butaka bwacyo;
cyangwa
ii. gufatanya no gufasha inzego zibifitiye
ububasha gukusanya cyangwa kwandika
amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho, mu gihe
nyacyo, afitanye isano n’itumanaho ryihariye
ku butaka bwacyo ryoherejwe hakoreshejwe
urusobe rwa mudasobwa.
2. Iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano,
kubera amahame yashyizweho y’imikorere
y’amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu,
kidashobora gushyiraho ingamba zavuzwe
mu gika cya 1.a, gishobora gushyiraho
ingamba z’amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zikenewe kugira ngo hakusanywe cyangwa
handikwe mu gihe nyacyo amakuru ajyanye
n’itumanaho ryihariye ryanyujijwe ku butaka
bwacyo, binyuze mu gukoresha uburyo bwa
tekiniki buri kuri ubwo butaka.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya masezerano
gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zishobora gukenerwa hagamijwe gutegeka
utanga serivisi kubika ibanga ukuri ku
ikoreshwa ry’ububasha ubwo ari bwo bwose
buvugwa muri iyi ngingo n'amakuru ayo ari
yo yose ajyanye na bwo.
4. Ububasha n’uburyo buvugwa muri iyi
ngingo bigomba gukurikiza ibivugwa mu
ngingo ya 14 na 15.

articles.heading: Igenzura ry’amakuru ajyanye n’ibigize amakuru 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba
articles.text:
zikenewe, ku bijyanye n’ibyiciro by’ibyaha
bikomeye bigomba kugenwa n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu, kugira ngo inzego
zibifitiye ububasha zigire ububasha bwo:
a. gukusanya cyangwa kwandika binyuze mu
buryo bwa tekiniki buri ku butaka bw’icyo
gihugu kiri muri aya masezerano, no
b. gutegeka abatanga serivisi, mu bushobozi
bwabo bwa tekiniki busanzweho:
i. gukusanya cyangwa kwandika binyuze mu
buryo bwa tekiniki buri ku butaka bwacyo,
cyangwa
ii. gufatanya no gufasha inzego zibifitiye
ububasha mu gukusanya cyangwa kwandika
ibigize amakuru, mu gihe nyacyo, bijyanye
n’itumanaho ryihariye riri ku butaka bwacyo
ryanyujijwe mu rusobe rwa mudasobwa.
2. Iyo igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano,
bitewe n'amahame y'amategeko yacyo,
kidashobora gushyiraho ingamba zivugwa
mu gika cya 1.a, gishobora gufata ingamba
z'amategeko n'izindi ngamba zishobora kuba
ngombwa kugira ngo hakusanywe cyangwa
handikwe ibigize amakuru mu gihe nyacyo
yerekeye itumanaho ryanyujijwe ku butaka
bwacyo hakoreshejwe uburyo
bw'ikoranabuhanga busanzwe buri kuri ubwo
butaka.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho ingamba z’amategeko n’izindi
ngamba zishobora gukenerwa mu rwego rwo
gutegeka utanga serivisi kubika ibanga mu
gihe bumwe mu bubasha bwacyo
buteganywa muri iyi ngingo bwashyizwe mu
bikorwa n'amakuru ayo ari yo yose ajyanye
na bwo.
4. Ububasha n’uburyo bivugwa muri iyi
ngingo bigomba gukurikiza ibiteganywa mu
ngingo ya 14 n’iya 15.
UMUTWE WA 3: UBUBASHA

articles.heading: Ububasha 1. Buri Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishyiraho amategeko n’izindi ngamba zishobora gukenerwa kugira ngo
articles.text:
hashyirweho ububasha ku cyaha icyo ari cyo
cyose cyateganyijwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 11
y’aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga, igihe
icyaha cyakorewe:
a. ku butaka bwacyo; cyangwa
b. mu bwato bufite ibendera ry'icyo gihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano; cyangwa
c. mu ndege yanditswe hakurikijwe
amategeko y'icyo gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano; cyangwa
d. n'umwe mu benegihugu bacyo, iyo icyaha
gihanwa n’amategeko mpanabyaha y’aho
cyakorewe cyangwa iyo icyaha cyakorewe
hanze y’aho igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
kigenzura.
2. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kwifata ku bijyanye
n’uburenganzira bwo gukurikiza cyangwa
kudakurikiza mu bihe byihariye amategeko
ajyanye n’ububasha ateganyijwe mu gika cya
1.b kugeza kuri 1.d cy’iyi ngingo cyangwa
igice icyo ari cyo cyose cyayo.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gifata ingamba zishobora gukenerwa kugira
ngo hashyirweho ububasha ku byaha
bivugwa mu ngingo ya 24 y’aya Masezerano
mu gika cya 1, mu gihe umuntu ukekwaho
gukora icyaha ari ku butaka bwacyo kandi
kitamwoherereza ikindi gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano ngo akurikiranwe, hashingiwe
gusa ku bwenegihugu bwe, nyuma yo gusaba
ko yoherezwa.
4. Aya Masezerano ntakuraho ububasha ubwo
ari bwo bwose bw’inshinjabyaha bukoreshwa
n’igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
hakurikijwe amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu.
5. Iyo igihugu kimwe cyangwa ibihugu
birenze kimwe biri muri aya Masezerano
bivuga ko bifite ububasha ku cyaha kivugwa
cyashyizweho hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’aya Masezerano, ibihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano bireba, iyo bibaye ngombwa,
bigisha inama hagamijwe kugaragaza
ububasha bukwiye bukoreshwa mu
ikurikirana.
UMUTWE WA III: UBUFATANYE
MPUZAMAHANGA
ICYICIRO CYA MBERE: AMAHAME
RUSANGE
UMUTWE 1: AMAHAME RUSANGE
YEREKEYE UBUFATANYE
MPUZAMAHANGA

articles.heading: Amahame rusange yerekeye ubufatanye mpuzamahanga Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba gufatanya, hakurikijwe ibivugwa
articles.text:
muri uyu mutwe, kandi binyuze mu ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry’amategeko mpuzamahanga
yerekeye ubufatanye mpuzamahanga mu
bijyanye n’urwego mpanabyaha,
amasezerano yumvikanyweho hashingiwe ku
mategeko ahuye cyangwa magirirane, ndetse
n’amategeko y’imbere mu gihugu, mu buryo
bwagutse bushoboka mu rwego rwo gukora
iperereza cyangwa gukurikirana ibyaha
bifitanye isano n’urusobe rwa mudasobwa
n'amakuru, cyangwa gukusanya ibimenyetso
by'icyaha cyo mu rwego mpanabyaha mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.
UMUTWE 2: AMAHAME AJYANYE
N’IYOHEREZWA
RY’ABAKURIKIRANWEHO IBYAHA

articles.heading: Iyoherezwa ry’abakurikiranweho ibyaha 1. a. Iyi ngingo ikurikizwa ku iyoherezwa ry’abakurikiranweho ibyaha byo mu rwego
articles.text:
mpanabyaha hagati y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano byateganyijwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 11
y’aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga, ariko
bakaba bagomba guhanwa n’amategeko
y’impande zombi bireba binyuze mu
kubambura umudendezo nibura mu gihe
kitarenze umwaka umwe cyangwa
bagahabwa igihano kirushijeho kuremera.
b. Iyo igihano gito gitandukanye kigomba
gushyirwa mu bikorwa hashingiwe ku
masezerano yemejwe hashingiwe ku
mategeko ahuye cyangwa ku mategeko
magirirane cyangwa ku masezerano yo
kohererezanya abakurikiranweho ibyaha,
harimo n'amasezerano y'Uburayi ku
iyoherezwa ry’abakurikiranweho ibyaha
(ETS N° 24), akurikizwa hagati y'impande
ebyiri cyangwa nyinshi, igihano gito
giteganyijwe muri ayo masezerano ni cyo
gikurikizwa.
2. Ibyaha byo mu rwego mpanabyaha
bivugwa mu gika cya 1 cy'iyi ngingo bifatwa
nk'ibikubiyemo ibyaha byo kohererezanya
ababikurikiranweho mu masezerano ayo ari
yo yose yo kohererezanya abakurikiranweho
ibyaha asanzweho hagati y’impande
zayagiranye. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano byiyemeza gushyira ibyo byaha
mu byaha byo kohererezanya
ababikurikiranweho mu masezerano ayo ari
yo yose yo kohererezanya abakurikiranweho
ibyaha hagati yabyo.
3 Iyo igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisaba ko kohererezanya abakurikiranweho
ibyaha biba itegeko kugira ngo habeho
amasezerano cyakiriye ubusabe bw’ikindi
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano bwo
kohererezanya abakurikiranweho ibyaha
bidafite amasezerano yo kohererezanya
abakurikiranweho ibyaha, gishobora gufata
aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga nk’ishingiro
ryo mu rwego rw’amategeko ryo
kohererezanya abakurikiranweho ibyaha
ibyoe ari byo byose bivugwa mu gika cya 1
cy'iyi ngingo.
4. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bidasaba ko kohererezanya
abakurikiranweho ibyaha hagomba kuba
hariho amasezerano, byemera ko ibyaha byo
mu rwego mpanabyaha bivugwa mu gika cya
1 cy’iyi ngingo ari ibyaha bituma
ababikurikiranweho bibohererezanya hagati
yabyo.
5. Kohererezanya abakurikiranweho ibyaha
bigomba gukurikiza ibiteganywa
n’amategeko y’igihugu kiri uri aya
Masezerano gisabwa cyangwa amasezerano
akurikizwa yo kohererezanya
abakurikiranweho ibyaha, harimo
n’impamvu zituma igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisabwa gishobora kwanga
kohererezanya abakurikiranweho ibyaha.
6. Iyo kohererezanya abakurikiranweho
ibyaha bivugwa mu gika cya 1 cy’iyi ngingo
byanzwe hashingiwe gusa ku bwenegihugu
bw’umuntu ushakishwa, cyangwa kubera ko
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
kibona ko gifite ububasha kuri icyo cyaha,
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
cyoherereza inzego z’igihugu gisaba
zibifitiye ububasha ikirego kugira ngo
zigikurikirane kandi kikamenyesha igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba imyanzuro
ndakuka mu gihe gikwiye. Izo nzego zifata
ibyemezo byazo kandi zigakora iperereza
n’ibikorwa bijyana na ryo mu buryo bumwe
nk’ubw’ibindi byaha bihuje imiterere
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’amategeko y’icyo
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano.
7. a. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
kigomba, mu gihe cyo gushyira umukono ku
Masezerano cyangwa iyo gitanga inyandiko
yo kuyemeza burundu, kuyemera, cyangwa
kwemeraa kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho , kumenyesha
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama
y’Uburayi izina na aderesi bya buri rwego
rushinzwe gutanga cyangwa kwakira ubusabe
bwo kohererezanya abakurikiranweho
ibyaha; cyangwa gufatwa by'agateganyo mu
gihe nta masezerano ahari.
b. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama
y’Uburayi ashyiraho kandi akomeza gushyira
amakuru mashya mu gitabo cy’abayobozi
bagenwe n’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano giharanira ko amakuru ari mu
gitabo aba ari ukuri igihe cyose.
UMUTWE WA 3: AMAHAME
RUSANGE YEREKEYE UBUFATANYE

articles.heading: Amahame rusange yerekeye ubufatanye 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba gufashanya mu buryo bwagutse
articles.text:
bushoboka hagamijwe iperereza cyangwa
iburanisha ku byaha byo mu rwego
mpanabyaha bijyanye n’urusobe rwa
mudasobwa ndetse n’amakuru, cyangwa
gukusanya ibimenyetso by’icyaha mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga.
2. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya masezerano
gishyiraho kandi amategeko n’izindi ngamba
zose zikenewe kugira ngo gikore inshingano
zivugwa mu ngingo ya 27 kugeza ku ya 35.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora, mu bihe byihutirwa, gusaba
ubufasha cyangwa itumanaho rijyanye na
bwo binyuze mu buryo bwihuse
bw’itumanaho, harimo fagisi cyangwa
ubutumwa bwa imeri, mu gihe ubwo buryo
butanga urwego rukwiye rw’umutekano no
kwizerwa (harimo n’ikoreshwa ry’ubutumwa
buhishwe mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga, iyo
bibaye ngombwa), hagakurikiraho kwemeza
ku mugaragaro, iyo bisabwe n'igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano. Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyemera kandi kigasubiza ubwo
busabe binyuze mu buryo ubwo ari bwo
bwose bw'itumanaho ryihuse.
4. Usibye ibiteganyijwe ukundi mu ngingo
ziri muri iki gice, gufashanya bigomba
gukurikiza ibisabwa n’amategeko y’igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano cyasabwe cyangwa
n’amasezerano akoreshwa mu gufashanya,
harimo n’impamvu Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyasabwe gishobora kwanga
ubufatanye. Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyasabwe ntigishobora
gukoresha uburenganzira bwo kwanga
gufashanya ku bijyanye n’ibyaha bivugwa
mu ngingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 11 hashingiwe
gusa ko icyifuzo kireba icyaha kibona ko ari
icyaha cy’imari.
5. Iyo, hakurikijwe ibivugwa muri uyu
mutwe, igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisabwa cyemerewe gushyiraho ihame
ry’uko ubufatanye bugomba kuba bushingiye
ku kuba icyaha kirebwa gifatwa nk’icyaha
mu gihugu gisaba n’igisabwa, iryo hame
rifatwa nk'iryubahirijwe, iyo imyitwarire
igize icyaha, ituma ubufasha busabwa, ifatwa
nk’icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko yacyo
y’imbere mu gihugu, amategeko y’imbere mu
gihugu yaba ashyira cyangwa adashyira mu
cyiciro kimwe cy’ibyaha cyangwa yaba
akoresha cyangwa adakoresha inyito imwe
n’iy’igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisaba.

articles.heading: Amakuru yihuse 1. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora, cyubahirije amategeko yacyo y’imbere mu gihugu kandi kitabanje
articles.text:
kubisaba, koherereza ikindi gihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano amakuru yabonetse mu
rwego rw’iperereza ryacyo bwite iyo gisanze
gutangaza ayo makuru bishobora gufasha
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyakira mu
gutangiza cyangwa gukora iperereza
cyangwa kuburanisha imanza zerekeye
ibyaha byo mu rwego mpanabyaha
byashyizweho hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’aya Masezerano cyangwa iyo ayo makuru
ashobora gutuma icyo gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba ubufatanye hakurikijwe
ibiteganyijwe muri uyu mutwe.
2. Mbere yo gutanga ayo makuru, Igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gitanga amakuru
gishobora gusaba ko yagirwa ibanga
cyangwa agakoreshwa gusa igihe biri
ngombwa. Iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano kiyakira kidashobora kubahiriza
icyo cyifuzo, kimenyesha Igihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano kiyatanga, kikagena niba ayo
makuru agomba gutangwa. Iyo Igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano cyakira cyemera
amakuru hakurikijwe ibisabwa, kigomba
kubyubahiriza.
UMUTWE WA 4: UBURYO BUJYANYE
NO GUSABA UBUFATANYE MU GIHE
HATARI AMASEZERANO
MPUZAMAHANGA AKURIKIZWA

articles.heading: Inzira zijyanye no gusaba ubufatanye mu gihe hatari amasezerano mpuzamahanga akurikizwa 1. Iyo nta masezerano y’ubufatanye ahari
articles.text:
hashingiwe ku mategeko ahuye cyangwa
magirirane akurikizwa hagati y’Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bisaba
n’ibisabwa, hakurikizwa ibivugwa mu gika
cya 2 kugeza ku cya 9 cy'iyi ngingo. Ibivugwa
muri iyi ngingo ntibikurikizwa aho ayo
masezerano cyangwa amategeko biri, keretse
iyo ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
birebwa byemeye gukurikiza imwe cyangwa
ibindi byose bisigaye muri iyi ngingo mu
mwanya wa yo.
2. a. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
kigena ubuyobozi bukuru cyangwa
ubuyobozi bushinzwe kohereza no gusubiza
ubusabe bw’ubufatanye, gushyira mu
bikorwa ubwo busabe cyangwa ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’ubwo busabe cyangwa
iyoherezwa ryabwo mu nzego zibifitiye
ububasha kugira ngo zibushyire mu bikorwa;
b. Inzego nkuru zibifitiye ububasha zivugana
hagati yazo mu buryo butaziguye;
c. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano, mu
gihe cyo gushyiraho umukono cyangwa mu
gihe cyohereza inyandiko yacyo yo kwemeza
burundu Amasezerano, , kuyemera cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho, kimenyesha Umunyamabanga
Mukuru w’Inama y’Uburayi amazina na
aderesi by’abayobozi bagenwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa muri iki gika;
d. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama
y’Uburayi ashyiraho kandi akomeza
kujyanisha n’igihe amakuru y’igitabo
cy’abayobozi bakuru bagenwe n’ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano. Buri gihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano giharanira ko
amakuru gifite mu gitabo aba ari ukuri igihe
cyose.
3. Gusaba ubufatanye hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa muri iyi ngingo bikorwa
hakurikijwe uburyo bwagenwe n’igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisaba, keretse iyo
binyuranyije n’amategeko y’igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisabwa.
4. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
gishobora, usibye impamvu zo kwanga
zivugwa mu ngingo ya 25, igika cya 4,
kwanga ubufasha iyo:
a. ubusabe bujyanye n’icyaha igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisabwa gifata ko ari
icyaha cya politiki cyangwa icyaha gifitanye
isano n’icyaha cya politiki, cyangwa
b. kibona ko ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ubusabe
rishobora kubangamira ubusugire,
umutekano, ituze rya rubanda cyangwa izindi
nyungu z’ingenzi.
5. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora gusubika ibikorwa iyo ibyo
bikorwa byabangamira iperereza
ry’inshinjabyaha cyangwa ibikorwa
byakozwe n’inzego zacyo.
6. Mbere yo kwanga cyangwa gusubika
ubufasha, igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisabwa kigomba, iyo bikwiye nyuma yo
kugisha inama igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba, gusuzuma niba ubusabe
bushobora gutangwa igice cyangwa
haseguriwe ku bisabwa gisanga ari
ngombwa.
7. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
gihita kimenyesha igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba icyo ishyirwa mu bikorwa
by’ubusabe bw’ubufasha ryagezeho.
Impamvu zo kwanga cyangwa zo gusubika
ubusabe ziratangwa. Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisabwa kandi kimenyesha
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba
impamvu zose zituma ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’ubusabe ridashoboka cyangwa zituma
rishobora gutinda ku buryo bugaragara.
8. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba
gishobora gusaba ko igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisabwa kigira ibanga
ibyerekeye ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bwakozwe hakurikijwe ibikubiye muri uyu
mutwe n’insanganyamatsiko yawo, keretse
gusa mu rugero rukenewe mu ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ryabyo. Iyo igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisabwa kidashobora kubahiriza
ubusabe bwo kugira ibanga, gihita
kimenyesha igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba, na cyo kikagaragaza niba
ubwo busabe bugomba gushyirwa mu
bikorwa.
9. a. Mu gihe byihutirwa, gusaba ubufatanye
cyangwa itumanaho bifitanye isano
bishobora koherezwa mu buryo butaziguye
n’inzego z’ubutabera z’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba ku bayobozi b'igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa. Muri ibyo
bihe byose, kopi yoherezwa ako kanya mu
buyobozi bukuru bw'igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisabwa binyuze mu buyobozi
bukuru bw'igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisaba.
b. Ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose cyangwa
itumanaho ryose risabwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa muri iki gika bishobora gukorwa
binyuze mu Muryango mpuzamahanga wa
Polisi Mpanabyaha (Interpol).
c. Iyo ubusabe butanzwe hashingiwe ku
biteganywa mu gaka a. k'iyi ngingo kandi
urwego rudafite ubushobozi bwo gusuzuma
ubwo busabe, cyohererereza ubwo busabe
inzego z’igihugu zibifitiye ububasha kandi
kimenyesha mu buryo butaziguye Igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba ko
cyabikoze.
d. Ubusabe cyangwa itumanaho ryakozwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iki gika bitarimo
ibikorwa by’agahato bishobora kohererezwa
mu buryo butaziguye n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha bw’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba ku buyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha bw'Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisabwa.
e. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora, mu gihe cyo gushyiraho umukono
cyangwa iyo cyohereza inyandiko yacyo yo
kwemeza burundu, kwemera, cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano, kimenyesha
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama
y’Uburayi ko, kubera impamvu z’imikorere
inoze, ubusabe bwatanzwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’iki gika bugomba kohererezwa
ubuyobozi bukuru bwacyo.

articles.heading: Ibanga n’ikumira ku ikoreshwa 1. Iyo nta masezerano y’ubufatanye ariho hashingiwe ku mategeko ahuye cyangwa
articles.text:
magirirane akurikizwa hagati y’igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisabwa n’igisaba,
hakurikizwa ibivugwa muri iyi ngingo.
Ibivugwa muri iyi ngingo ntibikurikizwa aho
ayo masezerano cyangwa amategeko biri ,
keretse iyo ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano birebwa byemeye gukurikiza
kimwe cyangwa ibindi byose bisigaye muri
iyi ngingo mu mwanya wayo.
2. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
gishobora gutanga amakuru cyangwa
ibikoresho mu rwego rwo gusubiza ubusabe
hubahirijwe ko:
a. bigirwa ibanga aho ubusabe
bw’ubufatanye mu by’amategeko
budashobora kubahirizwa mu gihe
hatabayeho iryo hame, cyangwa
b. bidakoreshwa mu iperereza cyangwa mu
bikorwa bitari ibivugwa mu busabe.
3. Iyo igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisaba kidashobora ibisabwa bivugwa mu
ngingo ivugwa mu gika cya 2, gihita
kimenyesha ikindi gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano, kikagaragaza niba amakuru
agomba gutangwa. Iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba cyemeye ibisabwa,
kigomba kubyubahiriza.
4. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano icyo ari
cyo cyose gitanga amakuru cyangwa ibintu
hashingiwe ku bisabwa bivugwa mu gika cya
2 gishobora gusaba ikindi gihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano gusobanura, ibyerekeranye
n’ibisabwa, imikoreshereze y’ayo makuru
cyangwa ibikoresho.
UMUTWE WA 2: INGINGO ZIHARIYE
UMUTWE 1: UBUFATANYE
BWEREKEYE INGAMBA
Z’AGATEGANYO

articles.heading: Kubungabunga vuba amakuru abitswe muri mudasobwa 1. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora gusaba ikindi gihugu kiri muri aya
articles.text:
Masezerano gutegeka cyangwa kubona
ubundi buryo bwo kubungabunga amakuru
byihuse hakoreshejwe urusobe rwa
mudasobwa, iri mu ifasi y’icyo gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano kandi ku bijyanye
n’igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba
kigamije gutanga ubusabe bwo gufashanya
mu gusaka cyangwa kuyinjiramo mu buryo
nk’ubwo, gufatira cyangwa kuyarinda nk’uko
cyangwa gutangaza amakuru.
2. Ubusabe bwo kubungabunga bwakozwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’igika cya 1
bugomba kugaragaza:
a. urwego rushaka kuyabungabunga;
b. icyaha gikurikiranwa n’iperereza
ry’inshinjabyaha cyangwa incamake y’ibintu
bifitanye isano;
c. amakuru abitswe muri mudasobwa agomba
kubungabungwa n’isano afitanye n’icyaha;
d. amakuru ayo ari yo yose aboneka
agaragaza ushinzwe kubika amakuru abitse
muri mudasobwa cyangwa aho urusobe rwa
mudasobwa ruherereye;
e. akamaro ko kuyabungabunga; na
f. ko Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishaka gutanga ubusabe bw’ubufatanye mu
gusaka cyangwa uburyo nk’ubwo bwo
kubona amakuru, gufatira cyangwa mu buryo
nk'ubwo bwo kurinda amakuru, cyangwa
guhishura amakuru ya mudasobwa abitswe.
3. Nyuma yo kwakira ubusabe bw’ikindi
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano, igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisabwa gifata ingamba
zose zikwiye zo kubika mu buryo bwihuse
amakuru yatanzwe hakurikijwe amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu. Mu rwego rwo gusubiza
ubusabe, guhana icyaha mu bihugu byombi
ntibifatwa nk’ihame kugira ngo
abungabungwe.
4. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba
guhana icyaha mu bihugu byombi nk’ihame
kugira ngo gisubize ubusabe bw’ubufatanye
mu bijyanye no gusaka cyangwa kubona
amakuru mu buryo nk’ubwo cyangwa
gutangaza amakuru yabitswe gishobora, ku
byerekeye ibyaha bitari ibyo byashyizweho
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 2 kugeza ku ya 11
y'aya Masezerano, kwifata mu bijyanye
n’uburenganzira bwo kwanga ubusabe bwo
kubungabunga hakurikijwe iyi ngingo mu
gihe gifite impamvu zituma gitekereza ko mu
gihe cyo gutangaza amakuru gusaba guhana
icyaha mu bihugu byombi bidashobora
kugerwaho.
5. Ikindi kandi, ubusabe bwo
kuyabungabunga bushobora kwangwa gusa
iyo:
a. ubusabe bujyanye n’icyaha igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisabwa gifata
nk’icyaha cya politiki cyangwa icyaha
gifitanye isano n’icyaha cya politiki,
cyangwa
b Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
kibona ko ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ubusabe
rishobora kubangamira ubusugire bwacyo,
umutekano, ituze rusange cyangwa izindi
nyungu z’ingenzi.
6. Iyo igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gisabwa kibona ko kubungabunga amakuru
bizatuma amakuru atazaboneka mu gihe
kizaza cyangwa bizabangamira ibanga
ry’amakuru cyangwa bizabangamira
iperereza ry’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba, gihita kimenyesha
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba, na
cyo kikagaragaza niba ubwo busabe
bugomba gushyirwa mu bikorwa.
7. Kubungabunga amakuru uko ari ko kose
kwakozwe ku mpamvu y’ubusabe buvugwa
mu gika cya 1 bugomba kuba mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi mirongo itandatu, kugira ngo
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba
gishobore gutanga ubusabe bwo gusaka
cyangwa kuyinjiramo mu buryo nk’ubwo,
gufatira cyangwa kuyarinda nk’uko cyangwa
gutangaza amakuru. Nyuma yo kwakira
ubwo busabe, amakuru akomeza gusigasirwa
mu gihe hagitegerejwe icyemezo kizafatwa
kuri ubwo busabe.

articles.heading: Gutangaza byihuse amakuru yabitswe ajyanye n’itumanaho 1. Iyo, mu gihe cyo gushyira mu bikorwa
articles.text:
ubusabe bwatanzwe hashingiwe ku
biteganywa n’ingingo ya 29 mu rwego rwo
kubungabunga amakuru ajyanye
n’itumanaho yerekeye itumanaho ryihariye,
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
kimenye ko ushinzwe gutanga serivisi mu
kindi gihugu yagize uruhare mu
gukwirakwiza itumanaho, igihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano gisabwa kigomba kwihutira
kumenyesha igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gisaba ingano ihagije y’amakuru
ajyanye n’itumanaho kugira ngo kimenye
uwo utanga serivisi n'inzira itumanaho
ryanyuzemo.
2. Gutangaza amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’igika cya 1
bishobora kwangwa gusa iyo:
a. ubusabe bujyanye n’icyaha igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano gisabwa gifata
nk’icyaha cya politiki cyangwa icyaha
gifitanye isano n’icyaha cya politiki;
cyangwa
b. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
kibona ko ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ubwo
busabe rishobora kubangamira ubusugire
bwacyo, umutekano, ituze rusange cyangwa
izindi nyungu z’ingenzi.
UMUTWE 2: UBUFATANYE
BUJYANYE N’UBUBASHA MU
BY’IPEREREZA

articles.heading: Ubufatanye bujyanye no kwinjira mu makuru abitswe muri mudasobwa 1. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishobora gusaba ikindi gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano gusaka cyangwa kuyinjiramo
hakoreshejwe uburyo nk’ubwo, gufatira
cyangwa kuyarinda muri ubwo buryo, no
gutangaza amakuru yabitswe hakoreshejwe
urusobe rwa mudasobwa iri mu ifasi
y’igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa,
harimo amakuru yabitswe hashingiwe ku
ngingo ya 29.
2. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisabwa
gusubiza ubwo busabe binyuze mu gukoresha
inyandiko z’amategeko mpuzamahanga,
amasezerano n’amategeko bivugwa mu
ngingo ya 23, kandi hakurikijwe izindi
ngingo zo muri uyu mutwe bijyanye.
3. Ubusabe busubizwa ku buryo bwihuse iyo:
a. hari impamvu zo kwizera ko amakuru
ajyanye na yo ashobora by’umwihariko
kubura cyangwa guhinduka; cyangwa
b. inyandiko z’amategeko, amasezerano
n’amategeko bivugwa mu gika cya 2
biteganya ubundi bufatanye bwihuse.

articles.heading: Kwambukiranya imipaka hagamijwe kwinjira mu makuru ya mudasobwa abitswe bitangiwe uburenganzira cyangwa iyo aboneka ku
articles.text:
mugaragaro
Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora,
nta ruhushya rw’ikindi gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano:
a. kwinjira mu makuru abitswe kuri
mudasobwa aboneka ku mugaragaro
(inkomoko y’amakuru ifunguye), hatitawe
kw’aho ayo makuru aherereye; cyangwa
b. kwinjira cyangwa kwakira, binyuze mu
rusobe rwa mudasobwa ku butaka bwacyo,
amakuru ya mudasobwa abitswe mu kindi
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano, iyo igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano kibona uruhushya
rwemewe kandi ku bushake bw’umuntu ufite
ububasha bwemewe n’amategeko bwo
gutangariza amakuru igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano binyuze muri urwo rusobe rwa
mudasobwa.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye mu bijyanye no gukusanya, mu gihe nyacyo, amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
bihana ubufasha mu gihe nyacyo bwo
gukusanya amakuru y’itumanaho ajyanye
n’itumanaho ryihariye ku butaka bwabyo
yakwirakwijwe hakoreshejwe urusobe rwa
mudasobwa. Haseguriwe ibivugwa mu gika
cya 2, ubu bufasha bugengwa n’ibisabwa
n’uburyo biteganywa n’amategeko y’imbere
mu gihugu.
2. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
kigomba gutanga ubwo bufasha nibura
bujyanye n’ibyaha by’inshinjabyaha, mu
gihe nyacyo, amakuru ajyanye n’itumanaho
mu rubanza nk'urwo rwaburanishirijwe
imbere mu gihugu ashobora gukusanywa.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye bujyanye n’igenzura ry’amakuru ajyanye n’ibigize ibitangazwa Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
bigomba gufashanya mu gihe nyacyo cyo
gukusanya cyangwa kwandika amakuru
y’ibyatangajwe mu itumanaho ryihariye
ryakwirakwijwe hakoreshejwe urusobe rwa
mudasobwa ku buryo bwemewe
n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga n’amategeko
y’imbere mu gihugu bikurikizwa.
UMUTWE III: UMUYOBORO
W’ITUMANAHO

articles.heading: Umuyoboro w’itumanaho 24/7 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kigena umuhuzabikorwa uzaba aboneka
articles.text:
amasaha 24 ku munsi, iminsi 7 mu
cyumweru, mu gihe cy’iperereza cyangwa
mu manza zijyanye n’ibyaha bifitanye isano
n’urusobe rwa mudasobwa n’amakuru,
cyangwa mu gukusanya ibimenyetso
by’ikoranabuhanga bijyanye n’icyaha.
Ubufasha nk’ubwo bugomba kubamo
koroshya cyangwa, iyo byemewe
n’amategeko n’imigirire yacyo, gihita
gishyira mu bikorwa ingamba zikurikira:
a. gutanga inama za tekiniki;
b. kubika amakuru hashingiwe ku ngingo ya
29 n’iya 30;
c. gukusanya ibimenyetso, gutanga amakuru
yo mu rwego rw'amategeko, no gushakisha
abakekwaho gukora ibyaha.
2. a. Umuhuzabikorwa w’ikindi gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano agomba kugira
ubushobozi bwo kuvugana
n’umuhuzabikorwa w’ikindi gihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano mu buryo bwihuse.
b. Iyo umuhuzabikorwa wagenwe n'igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano atabarizwa mu
rwego cyangwa inzego z’icyo gihugu
zishinzwe ubufatanye mpuzamahanga
cyangwa koherereza ikindi gihugu
abakurikiranweho ibyaha, umuhuzabikorwa
aharanira ko ashobora guhuza urwo rwego
cyangwa inzego ku buryo bwihuse.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
giharanira ko habaho abakozi bahuguwe
kandi bafite ibikoresho, kugira ngo boroshye
imikorere y'umuyoboro.
UMUTWE WA IV: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Ishyirwa ry’umukono ku Masezerano n’itangira gukurikizwa ryayo 1. Aya Masezerano ashobora kwemererwa
articles.text:
gushyirwaho umukono n’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango w’Inama y’Uburayi n’ibihugu
bitari ibigize Umuryango byagize uruhare mu
kuyategura.
2. Aya Masezerano yemerewe kwemezwa
burundu, kwemerwa cyangwa kwemezwa.
Inyandiko zo kuyemeza burundu, kuyemera
cyangwa kuyemeza zishyikirizwa
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama
y’Uburayi.
3. Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa ku
munsi wa mbere w’ukwezi gukurikira
irangira ry’igihe cy’amezi atatu nyuma
y’itariki ibihugu bitanu, harimo nibura
ibihugu bitatu bigize Inama y’ibihugu
by’Uburayi, byagaragaje ko byemeye kuba
bimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu gika
cya 1 n'icya 2.
4. Ku bijyanye n’igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
cyashyize umukono ku Masezerano
kigaragaza ko cyemeye kuyakurikiza nyuma,
Amasezerano atangira gukurikizwa ku munsi
wa mbere w’ukwezi gukurikira irangira
ry’igihe cy’amezi atatu nyuma y’itariki
cyagaragarijeho ko cyemeye kuba kimwe mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu gika cya 1 n'icya 2.

articles.heading: Kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano 1. Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikizwa kw’aya
articles.text:
Masezerano, Komite y’Abaminisitiri
b’Inama y’ibihugu by’Uburayi, imaze
kugisha inama no kubona uburenganzira
budasubirwaho bw’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano, ishobora gutumira igihugu icyo
ari cyo cyose kitari ikigize Inama kandi
kikaba kitaragize uruhare mu itegurwa
ry’aya Masezerano, kwemera kuba kimwe
mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano .
Icyemezo gifatwa ku bwiganze bwa benshi
buteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 20.d.
y’Amategeko agenga Inama y’ibihugu
by’Uburayi kandi ku bwumvikane
bw’abahagarariye ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bifite uburenganzira bwo kuba
muri Komite y’Abaminisitiri.
2. Ku bijyanye n’igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
cyemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’igika cya 1 haruguru, aya
Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa umunsi wa
mbere w’ukwezi gukurikira irangira ry’igihe
cy’amezi atatu nyuma y’itariki
Umunyambanga Mukuru w’Inama y’ibihugu
by’Uburayi yakiriyeho inyandiko yo
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano.

articles.heading: Iyubahirizwa ry’Amasezerano ku butaka bw’Igihugu 1. Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora, mu
articles.text:
gihe cyo gushyira umukono ku Masezerano
cyangwa mu gihe cyohereza inyandiko yacyo
yo kuymeza burundu, kuyemera, kwemeza
cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho, kwerekana agace cyangwa
uduce tw’ubutaka aya Masezerano
azubahirizwamo.
2. Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora, ku
munsi uwo ari wo wose nyuma yaho, binyuze
mu itangazo ryandikiwe Umunyamabanga
Mukuru w’Inama y’ibihugu by’Uburayi,
kugeza iyubahirizwa ry’aya Masezerano mu
kandi gace ako ari ko kose kagaragazwa
muri iryo tangazo. Ku bijyanye n’ako gace,
Amasezerano atangira gukurikizwa ku munsi
wa mbere w’ukwezi gukurikira irangira
ry’igihe cy’amezi atatu nyuma y’itariki
Umunyamabanga Mukuru yakiriyeho
itangazo.
3. Itangazo iryo ari ryo ryose ryatanzwe
hakurikijwe ibikubiye mu bika bibiri
bibanziriza iki, rishobora, ku byerekeye agace
ako ari ko kose kavugwa muri iryo tangazo,
gukurwaho n’imenyesha ryagejejwe ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru w’Inama y’ibihugu
by’Uburayi. Ivanwaho rigira agaciro ku
munsi wa mbere w’ukwezi gukurikira
irangira ry’igihe cy’amezi atatu nyuma
y’itariki iryo menyesha ryakiriweho
n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi z’ Amasezerano mpuzamahanga 1. Intego y'aya Masezerano ni ukuzuza amasezerano hagati y’ibihugu bibiri cyangwa
articles.text:
hagati y’ibihugu byinshi cyangwa
amasezerano hagati y’ibihugu bibiri
bigengwa n’aya Masezerano, harimo
ibivugwa mu:
- Masezerano y’Uburayi yerekeye
kohererezanya abakurikiranweho ibyaha,
yemerewe gushyirwaho umukono i Paris, ku
wa 13 Ukuboza 1957 (ETS N° 24);
- Masezerano y’ibihugu by’Uburayi yerekeye
ubufatanye mu by’amategeko mpanabyaha,
yemerewe gushyirwaho umukono i
Strasbourg, ku wa 20 Mata 1959 (ETS N°
30);
